item.title: Penn State Adds Commitment From 6-foot-6, 220-Pound Punter Lucas Tenbrock
item.description: Penn State continues to pillage Iowa State's signing class. item.title: Coroner: Hunter Found Dead After Search in Penns Valley Likely Died of Natural Causes
item.description: A hunter who was found dead in Penns Valley after a search that spanned Friday night and Saturday morning appears to have died of natural causes, according to the Centre County Coroner's Office. A neighboring land owner found the hunter at about 9:25 a.m. Saturday in a wooded area on private property in Gregg Township, Deputy Coroner Arika Rogers wrote in a press release on Sunday night. item.title: Second Hunter Found Dead in Centre County
item.description: A hunter was found dead after being reported missing on Saturday in Curtin Township, the Centre County Coroner's Office reported on Monday. It was the second case of a hunter being found dead after a search in the county over the weekend, and in both cases no foul play is suspect. The body of a hunter who the coroner's office says likely died of natural causes was found on Saturday morning in Gregg Township following a search the began on Friday night. item.title: Penn State’s Vega Ioane, Kaytron Allen Earn All-American Nods
item.description: A pair of Nittany Lions earned national recognition on Monday. Penn State left guard Vega Ioane and running back Kaytron Allen were named second- and third-team All-Americans, respectively, by the Associated Press. Both were previously selected first-team All-Big Ten honorees. With their selections, the Nittany Lions have had at least one All-American for five consecutive seasons, and 53 of the last 59. item.title: State College Council Approves 2026 Budget With 2-Mill Tax Increase
item.description: State College Council on Monday adopted a 2026 budget with a significantly lower real estate tax increase than originally proposed, though most members expressed reluctance about continuing the borough's structural deficit for another year. Council voted 5-2 in favor of a two-mill property tax increase as part of the $72.2 million fiscal plan.
